author: Tamás Pál
name: Rask Browser-WASM SPA
description: A standalone Rask app running entirely in the browser via WebAssembly.

auth.description: Scaffold a JWT bearer login against an external API (token in localStorage, attached as Authorization: Bearer). Point BaseAddress at your auth API — a standalone SPA has no host of its own.

pwa.description: Make the app an installable, offline PWA: adds a web app manifest + icon and registers Rask's default service worker (offline app-shell cache + Web Push) from index.html.

docker.description: Add a multi-stage Dockerfile + .dockerignore to containerize the app (publish the WASM bundle, then serve it from a static nginx:alpine image).
